# Humanizer for DSH

Rewrite text to sound natural while preserving its meaning and factual claims.

This is a skill-only DSH bundle; its upstream instruction body remains English while package metadata is localized. It adds no scripts, dependencies, network requests, or background services. See LICENSES.md for attribution.

## Automatic selection

Automatic selection is off by default for each Agent. Use `/dsh-humanizer-tonulls on` and `/dsh-humanizer-tonulls off`; direct Skill invocation remains available.
